messages.subject: Senior Thailand and ASEAN mandates | Corporate affairs, ESG and country leadership
messages.body:
Dear Michael Page Thailand Team,

I am seeking senior Thailand, ASEAN and APAC mandates where country leadership, government relations, corporate affairs or ESG sit close to business strategy.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My career spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My present role covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring direct experience dealing with ministries, regulators, communities, strategic partners and senior management around complex industrial priorities. My recent work also includes energy-transition stakeholder governance and carbon-data readiness. This gives me a practical profile for clients operating in regulated and investment-intensive sectors.

I would value consideration for Director, Head, Country Representative, Country Director, Chief of Staff, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability or Strategic Partnerships searches. I have attached a Michael Page Thailand-focused executive CV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
